text:
elaine: Heads up — SI co-sell intake is messy. We need clear ownership rules for leads that come via SI demos. Who owns account mapping once an SI qualifies? :thinking:

matt: +1. Current behavior in SFDC is inconsistent — sometimes SI owns opp, sometimes AE takes it over. Bad for forecasting.

carlos: From ops: we see 3 emergent buckets from past quarter: SI-led, Co-sell, Redwood-led. We should codify handoff triggers and a short SLA.

elaine: Proposed quick rules to pilot:
- SI-Only: <$50k ARR or PoC-only: SI owns the opportunity for 60 days (with optional escalation).
- Co-sell: >=$50k ARR and clear platform fit: AE + SI joint ownership; AE becomes primary owner in SFDC, SI remains partner contact.
- Enterprise / Strategic: Redwood sales owns; SI gets referral credit and enablement.

matt: Agree on thresholds. Add: if Redwood already has an active contract or P.O., Redwood owns regardless of ARR.

sami: Suggest change to the intake form to capture ARR estimate, buyer persona, procurement timeline, and whether SI ran a demo. I'll PR the form fields.

carlos: SFDC fields to add (ops request): `si_intake_bucket`, `si_primary_owner`, `handoff_date`, `handoff_reason`. Also a checkbox for "SI demo completed".

elaine: Good. Also: SLA for handoff acknowledgement — SI must ack handoff within 3 business days and propose next steps in 5. If no ack, AE auto-assigns and flags CS.

matt: I'll update the intake doc and the intake Zap. Will post the doc & PR within the hour. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

julia: Quick question on credits/comp: how will pipeline credit be split between SI and Redwood for quota/comp purposes?

elaine: For pilot, recommend defaults: SI-only = 70% credit to SI, Co-sell = 50/50 split, Enterprise = case-by-case (sales ops to adjudicate).

sami: Also proposing a weekly 30-min SI triage (Tue 11am PT) for new intakes >$25k to speed handoffs. Good cadence?

matt: Works for me.

deploy-bot: Document created: https://confluence.redwood.example.com/display/SI/SI+Intake+Handoff+Pilot (permissions: partnerships, sales)

elaine: Next steps: matt updates intake form & PRs the copy, carlos updates SFDC field mapping, sami creates calendar invite and updates triage notes, julia pulls comp ops into the thread. I'll send a summary email after we align.

matt: PR: https://git.redwood.example.com/partnerships/si-intake-form/pull/42 (adds ARR estimate + `si_demo_completed` field)

sami: Calendar invite sent for Tue 11am PT recurring, 30m. Invite: SI Triages — Partnerships+Sales.

julia: Looping in sales-ops@redwood to confirm comp credit flow and reporting.

elaine: We'll run the pilot for 30 days and track metrics: time-to-handoff, % unacknowledged handoffs, credit disputes. Will check back for metrics in 30 days. :rocket:
